units.title: Verify: Books and secret door state assets unit tests

tests.name: manifest contains objects/books, objects/secret-door-closed and objects/secret-door-open
tests.title: manifest contains objects/books, objects/secret-door-closed and objects/secret-door-open
tests.scenario: Given the the-boys-room manifest, When its asset ids are read, Then the three object ids are present
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/sg3ObjectAssets.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: every books and secret door file exists under public/assets
tests.title: every books and secret door file exists under public/assets
tests.scenario: Given the three manifest entries, When their paths are checked on disk, Then no file is missing
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/sg3ObjectAssets.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: svg width and height match the manifest dimensions for books and both door states
tests.title: svg width and height match the manifest dimensions for books and both door states

tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/sg3ObjectAssets.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: secret door closed and open entries have equal dimensions
tests.title: secret door closed and open entries have equal dimensions
tests.scenario: Given the closed and open door manifest entries, When their dimensions are compared, Then they are equal
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/sg3ObjectAssets.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.title: secret door closed and open SVG files have different contents

units.title: Verify: Boy sheets and glow effect assets unit tests

tests.name: boy spritesheets > character:boy > manifest entry is a spritesheet with a file on disk
tests.title: character:boy is a spritesheet entry whose file exists
tests.scenario: Given the real the-boys-room manifest, When character:boy is looked up, Then its type is spritesheet and its file exists under public/assets
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/sg3CharacterSheets.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: boy spritesheets > character:boy > svg width equals frameWidth * frameCount and svg height equals frameHeight
tests.title: character:boy SVG size matches its frame math
tests.scenario: Given character:boy frames, When the SVG width and height are read, Then width is 64 (32x2) and height is 48
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/sg3CharacterSheets.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: boy spritesheets > character:boy > declares a "idle" animation whose frame indices are all below frameCount
tests.title: character:boy idle animation references valid frames
tests.scenario: Given character:boy animations, When the idle frames are checked, Then the animation exists and every index is below frameCount
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/sg3CharacterSheets.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

units.title: Verify: Spritesheet frame and animation validation unit tests

tests.name: tests/sg3SheetValidation.test.ts > spritesheet validation > rejects a sheet whose frameCount overflows the sheet width
tests.title: rejects a sheet whose frameCount overflows the sheet width
tests.scenario: Given a 64x48 sheet with 32px frames and 3 frames, When parsed, Then validation fails at assets.0.frames.frameCount

tests.name: tests/sg3SheetValidation.test.ts > spritesheet validation > rejects an animation that references a frame outside frameCount
tests.title: rejects an animation that references a frame outside frameCount
tests.scenario: Given a 64x48 sheet with 2 frames and idle frames [0,5], When parsed, Then validation fails at assets.0.animations.idle.frames

tests.name: tests/sg3SheetValidation.test.ts > spritesheet validation > rejects a frameHeight larger than the sheet height
tests.title: rejects a frameHeight larger than the sheet height
tests.scenario: Given a 64x48 sheet with 60px tall frames, When parsed, Then validation fails at a path containing frameHeight

tests.name: tests/sg3SheetValidation.test.ts > spritesheet validation > accepts the committed the-boys-room manifest
tests.title: accepts the committed the-boys-room manifest
tests.scenario: Given the committed the-boys-room manifest.json, When parsed with parseManifest, Then validation succeeds
